cautions: FY2017 includes a partial year of EMC after the September 2016 merger; years through FY2019 include VMware, while FY2020 onward is recast continuing operations excluding VMware. Growth across incompatible scope is unavailable.
VMware was spun off in November 2021. FY2020-FY2021 closing capital and FY2022 opening capital can retain VMware while earnings exclude it; affected capital ratios are excluded from ranges.

Consolidated book capital includes DFS customer-financing assets and debt. Buybacks, negative equity, large trade payables and supplier finance make historical book ratios poor direct forecasts of required reinvestment.
Fiscal 2026 includes the first quarter disposal of Secureworks and VMware resale run-off. Recent AI-server growth and working-capital intensity can differ sharply from historical averages.
cautionsZh: 2017财年仅包含2016年9月合并后的部分年度EMC；截至2019财年包含VMware，2020财年起已重列为不含VMware的持续经营业务。跨不兼容业务范围的增长率不可用。
VMware于2021年11月分拆。2020至2021财年期末及2022财年期初资本可能仍含VMware，而盈利已排除；相关资本比率不纳入区间。
合并账面资本包含DFS客户融资资产及债务。回购、负权益、大额应付账款和供应商融资使历史账面比率难以直接预测再投资需求。
2026财年包含首季出售Secureworks及VMware转售业务收缩。近期AI服务器增长及营运资本需求可能明显偏离历史平均。
